draft.headline: Fox News Joins Major Outlets in White House Press Pool Boycott Over Coverage Ban
draft.body: The White House imposed a ban on Trump pool coverage, prompting Fox News to halt its reporting of the president's events. In response, Fox News aligned with other major networks—ABC, CBS, CNN, and NBC—to boycott the White House press pool. The participating outlets collectively asserted that no administration should restrict a news organization because it objects to its reporting. This coordinated boycott reflects a direct reaction to the coverage restrictions, linking the White House's policy decision to the networks' withdrawal from the pool.
